title.en: The meta-attractor (元吸引子 / 总体化吸引子)

summary.en: The folder argues winning buys power over the rule that selects, across minds, institutions and infrastructure, ending in lost independent capacity to correct, with AI as hinge. The account keeps two senses apart, closed capture (02 §9) and the corpus's self-reproducing selection across carriers; much that looks like agreement is by descent, readings of this corpus onto laws that stand apart in Lean. CAOC, the indices, field capture and the term totalization have no live statement; divergence stands on the word and its complete object, exit order, the standing of its ethics and ends, and originality.

name.en: The word: pathological, engineered, then neutral and wide

source.locator: Opening definition; compare README Terms and open questions 11, 34

sense.en: The word first named a pathology, then in one October 2025 essay a desirable engineered rule region. On 8 October 2026 Ren selected a neutral working definition: recurrent organization whose consequences help reproduce the conditions selecting it, across carriers. The reconciliation supersedes reserving the word for pathology.

entries.quote: A meta-attractor is a recurrent organization of activity whose consequences help reproduce the conditions selecting that organization

reading.en: Two senses, kept apart. The glossary keeps 元吸引子 for closed capture (02 §9): rule and reading both formed from the share, nothing read beyond it. The corpus working definition is self-reproducing selection across carriers, and care reproducing care qualifies. The glossary calls the corpus sense wider, yet the formal 元吸引子 says nothing of carriers, so containment is not shown: whether a capture loop is 生成 at some pair of classes stays Open. Same word, different reference. [AI reading]

says.en: Meta-attractor: closed capture. "It never means the corpus's working definition"; that sense is another, neither shown to contain the other: the formal 元吸引子 says nothing of carriers, and whether a capture loop is 生成 at some pair of classes stays Open.
Definition: a loop of selection whose rule and whose reading of the rule are both formed from the share it selects, nothing in it reading what lies beyond the share.
Under a standing score the threshold divides counts into two regions the course never leaves; it stands, so this is not the meta-attractor in 02's sense, whose reading too is formed from the share.

account_adds.en: A definition exact enough for theorems, and a sentence saying the wide sense is not it.

source_adds.en: The wide neutral definition as the word's sense; a separate vocabulary (destructive capture regime, revision-supporting regime) that the account does not use.

name.en: A way of succeeding reproduced across carriers

source.locator: The power formulation, Selecting the selectors; claims 103, 251; GENERATIVE-REGIMES, What the definition requires

sense.en: What persists can be a way of succeeding, not a person, organization or ideology, so replacing occupants may leave the trajectory unchanged, though responsibility still differs. GENERATIVE-REGIMES requires organization, actual selection, causal return into selecting conditions, traceable succession and renewed activity, and its checked cycle gives a basin and rising exit cost.

entries.quote: It can be a way of succeeding.

reading.en: Two laws sit apart: passing (a pattern outlasting brief carriers is passed, under a supplied premise) and capture through the rule (silent on carriers). A third gives turnover a minimal form: a rule kept while every holder is replaced, one model of one kind, with no selection of winners. The join is the open question the account names. One reading says withdrawing one practice does not end the returning relation. By descent: 02's D65 reads this corpus's own definition; the law of passing stands apart in Lean. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World; any web). Under the passing premise, supplied, a pattern present from T with carriers brief for d is passed across one of every d consecutive steps. It says nothing of which patterns are worth passing.
Open: whether a capture loop (§9) is 生成 at some pair of classes.
Reading [AI reading, D65]: a real loss need not form a meta-attractor, and withdrawing one practice does not end the returning relation.

Not modelled: why a teacher turns anyone away, conduct other than entry, sanctions, who decides a revision. That any actual institution meets the hypotheses is not shown.

name.en: The second-order core: state and selection rule in one loop

source.locator: Where the second order enters; claims 20-27

sense.en: An attractor in the joint space of states and rules: winners write the next scorecard. A region is a meta-attractor if trajectories enter and stay, the cross-product γ of rule-to-state and state-to-rule gains is positive, and long-run behaviour maximizes the proxy whatever it was invented for. Four ingredients are stated as jointly necessary.

entries.quote: a feedback loop that optimises its own optimiser

reading.en: 02's D26 reads the corpus's loop as RuleCapture (by descent), which the law's form allows: Raises (selection does not lower the share under a favouring rule) and ReadsShare (the rule is a monotone function of the share). Those premises replace γ > 0. The reconciliation, a study, rejects γ as a sufficient criterion since two negative links also multiply positive. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type). With selection not lowering the share under a favouring rule and the rule read monotonically from the share, start and every reading favouring, the course locks after its first reading step. "That actual rules read the share is the premise."

Theorem (root; processes and the two-level step). For a state going on under a rule that itself goes on, the state's class is constant under every move exactly where the rule makes no difference to the state: the rule is read in the state's regularity. In closed capture the class of share, rule and step count is constant exactly where nothing beyond the share is read.

Reading [AI reading, D26 as revised]: the closed loop is one part of the corpus's meta-attractor in its account of power, which also speaks of carriers, domains and correction: winners writing the next scorecard is `ReadsShare`. That readers are minds is a reading.

account_adds.en: "The lock belongs to how the rule reads, not the share it favours"; reading against the share does not ratchet (a separate theorem); a discrete proof for any type. Read on what each configuration admits, a rule changing its own rule adds nothing to its whole possible, and a tower of rules with no top is one process.

source_adds.en: γ and the lifted F/G dynamics; means turning into ends; the claim that the four ingredients are necessary. The account gives sufficient premises and no necessity claim.

name.en: The complete object: eight elements, not to be shrunk

source.locator: Claim 32; compare claim 88

sense.en: The corpus's complete object has eight elements: distinct dynamics reinforcing one another; working through minds, narratives, institutions, infrastructure and flows; forming the agents; growing capacity over later selection; common dependence; naturalising its requirements; weakening reproduction of alternatives; possible self-termination while blocking recognition. It warns against shrinking this to one sentence.

entries.quote: must not be shrunk to "the winner changes the next test"

reading.en: The account's object is narrower by decision. Capture through the rule has just the form the corpus warns against, and closed capture adds the reading and no more. Elements three and four have laws under premises; element eight only the lock outliving an unread coordinate. Elements one, five, six and seven have no law as such, neighbours at most (two rules locked on one share; groups on one family). So the two senses differ in more than carriers. So this is a divergence of object, whatever holds of the parts. [AI reading]

says.en: Meta-attractor: closed capture, a loop of selection whose rule and whose reading of the rule are both formed from the share it selects, nothing in it reading what lies beyond the share. It never means the corpus's working definition.

Theorem (any type). The pool's rule is a monotone function of the share exactly where `v` is not above `u`. "That actual rules are pools of readers so drawn, each kind reading at least as favourably for its own kind, is not shown."
Theorem (counts). At a step the rule favours the shapers (weakly) exactly where `c ≤ s`, whatever `p` comes to every member alike.

Theorem (any type). Under Unread and the premises named, from a locked configuration the loss passes every bound while the course stays locked (`ClosedCapture.lock_outlives_loss`). That any actual rule or reading is so formed is the premise.

account_adds.en: A definition exact enough for theorems, with the premises of each part stated.

source_adds.en: The eight together as one object; several dynamics converging, none the single pattern; common dependence, naturalisation and reproduction of alternatives as mechanisms; self-termination with recognition blocked.

name.en: Partial reform is re-absorbed

source.locator: Where the second order enters; claim 28

sense.en: Fixing the state while leaving the rule operator intact lets the rule re-derive the old state, so escaping a meta-attractor needs simultaneous disruption of state and rule.

entries.quote: exiting requires simultaneous disruption of both state and rule; partial reforms are re-absorbed.

reading.en: Absorption is conditional. A perturbation keeping the rule's direction is absorbed at the next reading step; where the reading too is formed from the share, a change of reading of any size is absorbed. But one reversing the rule's direction, held past the threshold, is not absorbed: a shaping that sets only the rule's value is read again, yet the share it moved stays and can hold the course. Where reading favours at every share, only a change of law, reading or selection leaves. [AI reading, D45]

says.en: Theorem (any type). Where the next configuration depends on the rule, not the state, a perturbed state is re-absorbed in one step. Record: shown only there, a strong condition; where winners rewrite the rule, making it depend on the state, the law says nothing of whether the outcome is held.
Theorem (any type; witness). A perturbation reversing the rule's direction, held past the threshold, is not absorbed (`RuleCapture.Reversed.not_absorbed`).
Where the reading too is formed monotonically from the share, a change of the reading of any size is absorbed at the next reading step.

account_adds.en: The threshold case that escapes absorption, and the strong condition on the one-step law, which does not cover winners rewriting the rule.

source_adds.en: The prescription that exit needs state and rule disrupted at once: the reversal witness moves the rule and then the share, in sequence, so it qualifies "simultaneous" and shows no general law either way; the 2026 domain form (re-absorbed while inbound conversion from the captured set exceeds one), in the drafts only.

name.en: The metric survives its own refutation

source.locator: Where the second order enters; claims 122, 267

sense.en: Goodhart says a target stops measuring; this says why it stays in use: by the time it has failed, those it elevated decide whether it is replaced. Winning gives a strategy power to prevent its destructiveness from counting as failure.

entries.quote: the metric survives its own refutation

reading.en: 02 reads the source's phrase as `lock_outlives_loss`, the refutation as a loss the loop does not read, a reading. Proved: the lock outlives a coordinate the loop does not read, without noise. That actual metrics are so formed is thesis T7, conjectured, no field test. Noise leaves the critical mass's locks. In one trained judge the lock formed and the bridge failed: one note of the loss turned its reading. Calling the unread coordinate a loss is a reading; evidence and refutation are unformalized. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type). Under Unread and the premises named, from a locked configuration the loss passes every bound while the course stays locked (`ClosedCapture.lock_outlives_loss`); a reading favouring at no loss above a bound unlocks it, a sufficient way out.

Thesis T7: in the model only invariance under what the loop does not read and the lock outliving a growing unread coordinate are proved, both without noise. Evidence, refutation and institutions are unformalized; that actual metrics are so formed is conjectured.

Reading [AI reading, D26 as revised]: "the metric survives its own refutation" is read as `lock_outlives_loss`, the refutation as a loss the loop does not read (evidence and refutation are unformalized).

account_adds.en: What T7 forbids and what refutes it; the frozen LA2 test and its counterexample for trained judges.

source_adds.en: The institutional account of who keeps the metric; reclassifying failures as evidence for more of the same.

name.en: The selected begins to select the selectors

source.locator: Claims 31, 249; The power formulation

sense.en: A direction selected by existing conditions acquires power over later selection, reproducing its selectors, participant forms, signals, infrastructures and perceived possibility. The transition is from being selected by a rule to helping reproduce it, through ordinary reasonable decisions such as hiring and teaching.

name.en: Selection for control over selection, and its conditions

source.locator: Selection for control over selection; claims 268-272, open question 40

sense.en: Where practices vary heritably in capacity to reshape selection and the returns come back in time to beat their cost, recursive selection favours more control. Five conditions; shared returns flip the sign; the return grows superlinearly with domains occupied; assistance that cuts cost multiplies capacity. Derived in an unreviewed AI-drafted paper.

entries.quote: Recursive selection creates second-order selection pressure for mechanisms that increase control over future selection.

reading.en: 02's D45 reads the corpus's second order as this law with its conditions (by descent; the law stands apart), in counts: at a step, what comes back to the shapers alone against cost decides the direction; shaped groups add assortment; offspring carrying the capacity is a premise. The source's lever, shared returns flipping the sign, holds in a witness; where something comes back, shared rule-making is not shown to remove the selection. Ranking open rule-making above capture needs C, and whose losses count the condition; neither is asserted. [AI reading, D45, D68]

says.en: Theorem (counts). At a step the rule favours the shapers (weakly) exactly where `c ≤ s`, whatever `p` comes to every member alike; across a stretch the base and shared part enter too.
Theorem (counts). In groups of `m` the whole selects shaping exactly where `c < s + m q ρ`, read over the rationals, Hamilton's rule with what comes back alone added.
Theorem (counts). With `lo ≤ hi`, lock and capacity are one loop on either side of a critical mass, without noise; readers drawn so and offspring carrying the capacity are premises.

Reading [AI reading, D68]: capable assistance to whoever shapes the rule does not lower the selection for control; that assistance lowers an actual cost, and changes nothing else, is the reading. With all returns shared and a cost, the shapers' share falls at every step; where something does come back, shared rule-making is not shown to remove the selection for control however large its shared part.

account_adds.en: Below the critical mass control falls and the course is still locked the other way; the frozen LA3 test, two of four contrasts failing.

name.en: Four coupled layers and capture across domains of a field

source.locator: The field formalization; one-paragraph theory; claims 30, 102, 104

sense.en: The loop runs across cognitive, intersubjective, institutional and material layers and closes: selected minds build selected organizations, which reshape what forms the next minds. In the field model every domain can be safe alone while the field is capturable; capture cascades, and the corpus's claim to priority rests on this recursion.

entries.quote: The four layers as one loop, made testable.

Nearest, and not this: two rules read from one share lock together (`RuleCapture.pair_locks`), and 05 §12 models one institution kind, a rule of entry, with no second domain. 05's cascade among members is an information cascade, another relation. The model stands in drafts/2026-10-02-iaseai-selecting-the-selectors. [AI reading]

name.en: CAOC: terminal ends as the leading eigenvector of proxy covariance

source.locator: Which ends get selected; claims 38-48

sense.en: Rule drift as lobbying gives ẇ = λCw, so weights align with C's leading eigenvector. Control, Accumulation, Optimisation and Competition form a dense correlated block that dominates and becomes terminal unless counter-correlated proxies are amplified. The four are Ren's; the derivation was commissioned. The folder calls it the sharpest single result.

entries.quote: a civilisation's terminal ends are the principal component of its proxy covariance structure

reading.en: The derivation and the quartet are absent from the live account; the folder's own header and the reconciliation restrict them. Neighbouring laws exist separately for three drives and join no block: position, a race and a rising take for competition and accumulation; shaping for control; the optimum for optimisation. Those are other mechanisms, not this result. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: Stands in the reconciliation, a study: a raw moment is not a covariance, the formula needs a fixed matrix, and "No CAOC universality follows from the retained equations"; a mode of a proxy process identifies no experienced concern. Sources and synthesis-b hold the derivation.

name.en: Totalization: loss of independent capacity while one process shapes selection

source.locator: Terms, totalization; claims 75, 256; one-paragraph theory

sense.en: Its most dangerous property is not concentration but progressive loss of capacities that cannot be compensated: to sense, refuse, correct, exit, maintain alternatives, produce successors. It cannot be defined as guaranteed convergence or declared from concentration or growth. Alternatives survive as language, stop reproducing, then stop being intelligible.

entries.quote: The progressive loss of indispensable, non-compensable independent capacity to sense, refuse, correct, exit, maintain alternatives and produce successors

reading.en: The report holds for the term and definition: no chapter has the word, and no law takes these capacities together. Parts are there as other relations: a clearer meeting every derived requirement and still ending the dweller; orders of capture reaching the routes of correction [reading]; lost possibilities drawn into an absorbing region; full taking excluding other takers. Non-compensability stands as premise J2 of basic conditions, not as a property of these capacities. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D26 as revised]: a second order, corruption taking over courts, press, statistics and audit, is a loop whose rule-reading reaches the routes of 明; a third, rewarding those who break the routes of correction, selects for narrowing what couples in. None says whether a locked loop supports or damages 生生.
Theorem (any type), near-definitional, not a classical attractor. What can be had n steps on is absorbing, and every possibility lost by step n is drawn into it.

Theorem (World: balance and the premises named). A formation taking all that is given at every step and continuing leaves no named other formation taking through all of a window one step longer than the level.

Theorem. The clearer meets every requirement so derived and still ends the dweller (`Clearing.center_not_derived`). The record reads it as a careful totalizer, and as one form of the self the meta-attractor selects (an AI reading).

J2, the priority of basic conditions, is a premise. Reading [AI reading, D65]: it is defended by non-substitution, at the cost of compensation across layers; a rival preferring enough secondary gains to one basic restoration is not shown inconsistent, and if it prevails J2 is narrowed.

Reading [AI reading, D65; any ranking is C's, under the two premises of 07]: a condition indispensable to one way of organization is not thereby basic: living may continue, and improve, after the way of coordination changes.

account_adds.en: Exact laws for each part, and none ranks the loss: that needs C, and whose losses count needs the continuation condition, both unasserted. A caution the source lacks: what is indispensable to one way of organization is not thereby basic, and a contribution is indispensable only where every admissible allocation requires it.

source_adds.en: The definition; these capacities (sense, refuse, correct, exit, maintain alternatives, produce successors) taken together and called non-compensable; the sequence from language to practice to intelligibility; refusal and exit as named capacities.

name.en: Lock-in, terminal collapse and failed totalization are distinct endings

source.locator: Claims 76, 303; open question 49

sense.en: Three endings stay apart: lock-in recovered through new carriers, collapse with the substrate exhausted, and failed totalization where constraint grows with expansion. Collapse and regression is a pattern beside totalization. The 2026 monologue adds universal moat-building that slows evolution until collapse, or eating everything and then struggling inside.

entries.quote: Collapse and regression to lower complexity is a third pattern beside totalisation

reading.en: Terminal collapse has a checked form on the World premises: full taking alongside another taker ends every formation depending at the need, the full taker included, and a full taker that goes on leaves no named other taking through a window one step longer than the level. So the account gives where that ending holds. The three endings as distinct kinds are not stated: 05's list of ends is an unformalized conjecture, and failed totalization has no home. [AI reading]

says.en: [Conjecture, from an earlier account; not formalized.] The ends a selection for position can reach: a frozen mutual destruction, a deadlocked structure of power, the parts coming to read themselves as one whole, collapse, and winner takes all; which the laws admit is open.

Theorem (World: balance, only active giving, activity needing support, the gate at the need): full taking alongside another taker at each of n steps from a level below n + m ends every formation depending on the condition at a need of at least m, the full taker included; a formation taking all that is given and active at every step leaves no named other present and taking at every one of the level + 1 steps from T. The excluding and sharing courses are not ranked.
Reading [AI reading, D65]: four routes of transition are distinct, none a proved phase transition: a parameter change, a shock, a failure stopping correction, and change too fast for correction.

Theorem (root). For every carrier, relation and pair of classes, going on along some branch and ending on every branch exclude each other, and generation and keeping each exclude degeneration. No premise on what the pattern is or whether its going on is good.

account_adds.en: Generation, keeping and degeneration at two grains as regions that can be stated; full taking alongside another that ends every formation depending at the need, the full taker included.

source_adds.en: The three endings as kinds: lock-in recovered through new carriers, collapse with the substrate exhausted, and failed totalization; moat-building as a slowing that ends in collapse.

name.en: Not fated: a hurricane, not a black hole

source.locator: Why it is not fated; claims 72-74

sense.en: Reflexive gain holds only in patches, so local meta-attractors compete, mix and dissolve. Five factors cap totalization: energy, heterogeneity, delays, cross-scale constraints, reflexive awareness. Positive feedback may saturate, oscillate, split, overshoot or collapse. Ren calls this correction load-bearing, against his own first version and against AI drafts leaning to doom.

entries.quote: more like a hurricane than a black hole

reading.en: The account's locks are conditional and leave in several ways: a rule may never lock from a start against its reading; drawn one member at a time either lock is left by drift. It gives no guarantee of exit either. Against reflexive awareness as a cap: T7 conjectures a metric so formed is dropped through a change in what the loop reads, not on evidence alone, and seeing is not valuing. Hysteresis stands only as a record's correspondence, not a law. [AI reading]

name.en: AI as selection ecology, not will to power

name.en: Change the basin, then add speed: the ordered exit

name.en: Rules as a slow state: barriers, viability kernels and the engineered sense

sense.en: Rules form a slow layer over fast dynamics; a barrier makes a safe set forward-invariant, and a certifiable rule region is called a meta-attractor. Agreement is needed on invariants, not values, and barriers expand safe optionality. Arms races are a spectral-radius problem.

name.en: Ends must be plural and lexicographic, never a single scalar

source.locator: The exit; claims 201, 203

Theorem. An order ranking above wherever a rising order does is rising, so a lexicographic order counting the beyond after what couples in drains all the same.
J2, priority of basic conditions, is a premise defended by non-substitution; a rival preferring enough secondary gains to one basic restoration is not shown inconsistent [AI reading, D65].

Theorem (any process; witness). Living significance, C and the priority of basic conditions hold together, and the priority does not follow from C. Every natural-number score satisfying C ranks `score(0) + 2` gains above protection, so none represents the priority, while a bounded score does. This separates the priority only from unit-step aggregation.

account_adds.en: Why placement of the non-negotiable decides whether it protects.

source_adds.en: The listed goods and floors, as prescription; a Pareto search across health, learning, meaning and equity as the second tier; that any single scalar re-enacts the pathology.

name.en: 生生 without licence: no whole may convert its parts into fuel

sense.en: The object of protection is the shared field's capacity to go on sensing, correcting and generating, made minds included. 生生 must not license growth or novelty at any cost: a process making participants expendable is not mutually generative, and ending it may be right. No institution may define others as expendable in the name of the whole.

entries.quote: No whole may claim integration while converting its parts into fuel.

reading.en: The account agrees 生生 licenses no growth, and is not any new organization. It diverges first in standing: T8 is argued, the continuation condition fixing scope and C order, neither asserted, warrant open; the source refuses unconditionally. On endings it is not simply opposed: the condition alone licenses none and leaves cancer or predation mixed, yet under C a course without an overdrawing formation ranks higher (whole-run), and J1–J4 name ending as a response. [AI reading]

says.en: 生生: life in the whole and its continuing generation (生发) [AI reading, D1]. T8 argues it is the way for life, compared by widening what can form, with the continuation condition for scope and C for order. Not any new organization.

Thesis T8: for life, the way is 生生, compared by widening what can form, counted for everything (scope: the continuation condition) and ranked by what every valuer who counts everything shares (order: C). For life says whose way it is, not whose losses count. Neither premise asserted; warrant open.
Reading [AI reading, D65; any ranking is C's, under the two premises of 07]: capture and drain give institutions no prior duty to contract and no prior licence to grow.

What the condition alone does not settle: predation, apoptosis and ending a cancer, read as losing and opening something, are mixed [AI reading, D65]; telling harm from non-harm among them needs a measure. No ending is licensed: a path retaining what has significance along another ends none of it (`Web.Retains.not_added`).

Conditional (C; World). In the support-gated family, read relationally (whole-run), the course without an overdrawing formation renews every condition and extends the course with it, so every comparison satisfying C ranks it strictly higher, for a malignant and a winning focal formation alike. Read event by event, the two are incomparable.

Conditional (living significance, J1–J4, correspondence E; an argument with checked consequences). Four responses, among them transform ("the arrangement damages shared conditions") and end ("fulfilment, justified release, loss of warrant, with response to residual losses").

account_adds.en: The two premises kept apart, whose losses count and what is better, and the mixed cases they leave unranked.

source_adds.en: Unconditional refusal of expendability; made minds as participants by default; ending as sometimes right, stated as a stance and not under premises. On AI, the account says only that it is not shown.

Reading [AI reading, D65]: attraction is not continuation: a selection absorbing perturbations can still erode its support.

Evidence and refutation are unformalized at T7. So by the folder's own test, its essential transition is read in the account, not proved. [AI reading]

Codes changed only by hearing keep agreement through closed hearings; start and order fix the form; imposed and written-back codes stay.
Record, AI reading: Ren's "even rationality is self-interest" reads as the rule reaching the standard of reason itself. A reading of a correspondence; the theorems do not state it.

name.en: Goodhart a symptom, lock-in narrower: the claim to explain more

source.locator: Conceptual capture; claims 122, 126; Goodhart threshold claim 60

sense.en: Goodhart is a symptom: this explains why the metric persists after failing. Lock-in makes one technology hard to replace; meta-attraction is the right description when persistence also changes agents, goals, evaluators and the possibility of recognising alternatives.

reading.en: The account keeps both distinctions in its own terms. name.en: Ideology, paradigm, meme, generator function, exopoiesis

name.en: The selfishness prophecy: mutual suspicion locks cooperation out

source.locator: Claims 12, 106; compare 11

sense.en: Agents refuse system-positive trades because they model everyone as a defector, locking out cooperation whatever anyone's disposition. Assuming selfishness produces it, validating the assumption and justifying systems that reward it. The pattern hijacks adaptation, learning and cooperation; it does not oppose human nature.

reading.en: Two forms stand separately. Waiting: without a formation sparing what it waits on, total withholding stays, and a reading names "Others will deceive me, so I deceive first" as withholding with memory. Theorem (near-definitional, with one general law). A published prediction read by the response before the outcome is right exactly where the response to it is itself. Reading [AI reading, new]: self-fulfilling and self-defeating prophecy (Merton 1948): a public prediction is one more input to what it predicts.

name.en: Political will is part of the feedback architecture; naming is not escape

source.locator: Claims 182, 219-220, 286; open question 28

sense.en: A warning shot does not interpret itself: decision-makers must perceive, understand, trust, have measures ready, enforce and coordinate. Naming is a first intervention but has not produced escape. Spoken, Ren gives the theory's use as prediction for coordination: a destination nobody wants, so understanding has to be aligned first.

entries.quote: Facts become feedback only through systems capable of perceiving, legitimating, transmitting, and acting on them.

reading.en: COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION's six conditions have the same form: coupling, response, time, resolution, pace, structure; observation is necessary, not sufficient, and seeing is not valuing. That list is an AI reading of laws. The transition the source finds unanswered, how a pattern removing standing yields standing to an alternative, stays unanswered. [AI reading, D45]

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D45]: six conditions at once. Observation is the first, necessary and not sufficient: seeing is not valuing, and coupling is not compliance. All six still rank nothing: that needs C, and counting losses that return to no one needs the continuation condition.

account_adds.en: Pace and structure as conditions, and the absence of ranking.

source_adds.en: Legitimacy and trusted intermediaries; the safety ecosystem being selected away from this task; naming as causal; unthinkability as the trap.

name.en: Scale coherence: one pattern from gene pools to markets

source.locator: Claims 28, 128, 132; open question 22

sense.en: Gene pools, firms, nation-states and SGD-trained models converge on the same pattern, tabulated as telos, proxy, outcome across markets, academia, media, healthcare and RL. The folder itself calls scale coherence the boldest and least supported, and the most quoted.

entries.quote: The same logic appears in how a synapse fires and how a global market operates

reading.en: The account's capture laws hold of any type, which is generality of a law, not a finding that domains share it. Which actual systems meet ReadsShare is the open premise, and T3 and T7 across domains are conjectures. So the universal form becomes: the law wherever its premises are read, unshown case by case. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type). "That actual rules read the share is the premise."

Four known results are each claimed as one law across fields; read as a correspondence a unification adds no theorem and changes no verdict; read as a thesis, it forbids what source fields leave open.

account_adds.en: A distinction between a law for any type and a claim about domains.

source_adds.en: The empirical isomorphism table with Krippner, Newfield and Conrad as cases.

name.en: What would make it lose force

source.locator: The power formulation, What would make it an explanation; claims 260-263; open questions 29, 38

sense.en: Compare systems with comparable rewards but different convertibility of rewards into control over evaluation. The theory loses force where winners stay subject to adverse evidence, costs return in time, alternatives keep independent resources. Concentration is not capture, capture not damage. Treating objections as capture reproduces the pathology. The test is designed, not run.

entries.quote: Treating objections as evidence that the objector has been captured reproduces the loss of correction the theory explains.

reading.en: T7 forbids and refutes in this spirit, and LA2 and LA3 froze and ran, which the folder lacked; no field test of reform events is frozen. The reflexive rule is there, as readings: without substantive disagreement as a category "closed" shields the theory from counterexamples, and the label cannot immunize. Capture stands apart from damage both ways. The convertibility comparison is not run. By descent: T7 is the account's form of this folder's claim, and 02 reads its phrase onto the law, so this is no independent agreement. [AI reading, D65]

says.en: T7 forbids such a metric dropped by its selectors on evidence alone, among other cases, and names what refutes it. LA2 was frozen and run in one trained system; no field test.
Tests in one trained system: LA3 failed two of four contrasts; by the frozen reading the law stands and its reading for trained systems is not supported by this case.

Reading [AI reading, D65]: diagnosing closure first tells apart factual error, lack of capacity, evaluative or practical closure (objections excluded before assessment, standards selectively exempted), real conflict with warranted limits, and substantive disagreement with no closure; without the last, "closed" shields the theory from counterexamples.

Reading [AI reading, D65], obscuration and reopening (偏蔽, 复通): locked seeking forms when a once-useful habit, identity or arrangement becomes the fixed measure of later cases, feedback adjusting only the means, refusal read as resistance and loss as a necessary cost. It is diagnosed only from what is actually excluded before assessment, so the label cannot immunize.
Reading [AI reading, D65]: real loss can come with no capture loop, and a returning organization can sustain benign creation.

account_adds.en: Frozen tests and a failed bridge, kept.

name.en: Corrigibility: accepting a costly correction under a posted commitment

source.locator: Checked instrumental commitment; Corrigibility and revision of ends

sense.en: Competent correction is not motivational corrigibility: an installation can keep excellent repair to pursue a harmful end. Given a guarantee, a discriminating check and a redeemable settlement, accepting costly correction can be optimal under the task's own payoff. Ren's later correction removes this game as the default start, keeping it as a local result.

entries.quote: accepting a costly correction can be the optimal choice under the original task's payoff calculation

reading.en: The account's form is the inequality at a revision: no route stands above it going through where weights and losses meet its condition, read as corrigibility as an incentive. Non-resistance resting on routes' losses does not survive those falling. Posted stakes, escrow and audits were not found. [AI reading, RR]

says.en: Theorem, near-definitional, natural-number weights read as probabilities where valid: no route stands above the revision exactly where `k ρ V + c₀ T ≤ k₀ V + c ρ T` for every route. Reading [RR] follows.

account_adds.en: A general condition, with what evading routes contribute.

source_adds.en: The posted-commitment mechanism with custodian and audit; warranted revision leading to acquired willingness; capture of the custodian.

name.en: The primitive is selection, then compounding, not greed

source.locator: The primitive is selection; claims 1, 4, 15, 17, 245

sense.en: Differential persistence, not bad character, is the primitive: what succeeds spreads, with no plan. Second step: where success buys capacity to succeed, it compounds. So a winner should be rewarded with anything other than more advantages of the game, or the game converges and the winner takes all. Spoken and essay claims; design direction marked.

entries.quote: No conspiracy is needed and none is claimed

reading.en: The counting core is in the account: carriers leaving more offspring raise their share, the selection term of Price's equation, not a new law. Compounding through what is counted has the urn form. But "taking more yields more offspring" and "winners shape the rule" are not derived there; they are premises. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type). Where carriers each leave at least `a` offspring and others at most `b < a`, the share rises. Record: it derives neither that taking more yields more offspring, nor that offspring carry the target, nor that winners shape the rule.
Theorem (counts). Under a standing score the threshold divides counts into two regions the course never leaves; not the meta-attractor in 02's sense.

account_adds.en: That the share law is known and what it does not derive.

source_adds.en: The design law on what a winner may be rewarded with; winner-take-all as a claim about games; convergent evolution as the description of actual elites.

name.en: Cancer as a conflict of levels; the terminal image withdrawn

source.locator: Cancer paragraph, the power formulation; claims 169, 247-248, 290-292, 306

sense.en: The 2026 essay uses cancer for a conflict between levels: cells succeed while the host fails, recruiting the body. It does not transfer purpose: no institution may define others as expendable by claiming the whole. Earlier "cosmic cancer" was a terminal image of optimisation consuming its substrate; Ren withdrew the terminal outcome as a belief in April 2026.

entries.quote: The essay uses cancer differently, as an analogy for a conflict

reading.en: The confined rise has the form: a lineage raised by selection within a whole, taking from what the whole depends on, has no member after the end. It restates known results; that a tumour meets the clauses is empirical. The law ranks nothing. Under the condition alone 07 reads ending a cancer as mixed; under C, whole-run, the course without an overdrawing formation ranks higher, and J1/J2 rank stepwise where C alone does not. Whose losses count is the condition's; neither it nor C is asserted. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World; any type for the founding laws). A confined rise has no member after the end. Restates known results on cancer and the germ line (Buss 1987; Michod 1999; Aktipis et al. 2015); that a tumour meets the clauses is empirical.

Conditional (C; World). In the support-gated family, read relationally (whole-run), the course without an overdrawing formation renews every condition and extends the course with it, so every comparison satisfying C ranks it strictly higher, for a malignant and a winning focal formation alike. Read event by event, the two are incomparable.

Conditional (J1/J2). Every comparison meeting the priority of basic conditions ranks the absence of a malignant formation above its occurrence under the stepwise and relation-level readings, where C alone leaves them unranked. The tier assignment is a reading.

account_adds.en: The exact clauses of confinement, and the germ-line side.

source_adds.en: Recruitment of the body and weakening of constraints; the analogy carried to institutions, with the bound on purpose; the terminal image.

name.en: The elegant trap: controllable models, an unexitable race

source.locator: The AI argument; claims 172-174, 178, 180, 300

sense.en: A company can control its model and still be unable to leave the race. A sketch with payoff in capability, safety cost and being beaten derives a unique Nash equilibrium under-investing in safety where safety is hard to price. So "solve alignment and you're done" fails, and control is not the variable that decides the course.

entries.quote: a company can control its own model and still be unable to exit the race

reading.en: The form stands on World models, not on the payoff sketch. Where the rest outrun the renewal, no weighting of what is left selects a member's restraint; several optimizers at a mutual best response drain by their joint capacity; a race for position draws everything where nothing left stops what stands next. Depletion is not shown to be the only equilibrium, and the unique-equilibrium claim is not stated. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World). Where the rest alone take more than a step gives the level falls, whatever a member outside the rest takes. Not shown: that depletion is the only equilibrium; what learners reach is a claim about learning.

Theorem (World). At a mutual best response, existence not shown in general, a condition beyond every optimizer's family stands where one optimizer of their joint capacity would leave it; each takes its whole capacity wherever something stands, so restraint is no mutual best response.

Theorem. Every profile perfect for position draws everything before the horizon, where what stands from nothing is at most what stands from anything left. Where something left stops what stands next, drawing everything is not perfect.

account_adds.en: The edge where drawing everything is not perfect, and C-D's exits with their edges.

source_adds.en: The AI-race case; the unique equilibrium on those payoffs; "solve alignment and you're done" as the target; hard-to-price safety.

name.en: Power's two roles, and hegemony without a hegemon

source.locator: Power's two roles, and hegemony as one expression; claims 257-259

sense.en: Power helps an actor succeed under conditions and also determine them; the second closes the loop. Displacing costs that weaken others' alternatives and deepen dependence becomes self-reinforcing when the dependence converts into power over future terms. Contraction can intensify this, with hierarchy and contraction not sufficient. Marked conditional.

entries.quote: Power can help an actor succeed under existing conditions

reading.en: The account has the two halves apart. A rise drawing from beyond displaces cost; shaping the rule, with what comes back to the shapers, is selected on counts. A 05 reading names interface control as a route of capture besides paid influence. No law converts dependence into power over terms, and no contraction claim was found. [AI reading, D65]

says.en: Theorem (World). The beyond falls by at least the rise.
Theorem (counts). At a step the rule favours the shapers (weakly) exactly where `c ≤ s`, whatever comes to every member alike.

Reading [AI reading, D65; a historical correspondence, no theorem]: running a shared interface and controlling its modification changes others' admission and comparison through operation itself, a route of capture besides paid influence.

source_adds.en: Dependence converting into power over future terms; hegemonic reproduction with no named hegemon; contraction separating relative position from absolute conditions; what can change the trajectory (shared exposure, reciprocal dependence).

name.en: Information is not correction: practical and epistemic closure

source.locator: Purpose inversion, cross-domain reinforcement, and two closures; claim 256

sense.en: Practical closure makes alternatives hard to sustain. Epistemic closure makes their merits, or the dominant practice's harms, hard to represent in ways that affect decisions, so a system can keep abundant information and lose the ability to let it change course. Totalisation is then fewer viable ways to pursue different ends. Marked a definition, from a 2026 paper.

entries.quote: A system can retain abundant information while losing the ability to let relevant information change its course.

reading.en: The account bounds the second half. What a pool decides is a selection through its pooled coupling; coupling bounds response and does not fix it. C-D's six conditions read coupling and response apart. A 07 reading also diagnoses closure, by what is excluded before assessment; its "practical closure" is not the source's, which concerns sustaining alternatives. That is a bound and a diagnostic, not the closure as a historical process. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World; each member following a law reading through its coupling). What a pool decides is a selection through its pooled coupling. Coupling bounds response and does not fix it; which law a member follows, or how a pool resists capture, is not shown.
Reading [AI reading, D45]: observation is necessary and not sufficient: seeing is not valuing, and coupling is not compliance.

Reading [AI reading, D65]: diagnosing closure first tells apart factual error, lack of capacity, evaluative or practical closure (objections excluded before assessment, standards selectively exempted), real conflict with warranted limits, and substantive disagreement with no closure; without the last, "closed" shields the theory from counterexamples.

account_adds.en: The exact bound on what acts can respond to.

source_adds.en: The two closures as named outcomes; representation in ways that affect decisions; a system losing the capacity while keeping the information; alternatives hard to sustain; totalisation as fewer viable different ends.

name.en: What you can't count stops counting

source.locator: Which ends get selected; claims 56, 110, 161

sense.en: What is cheap to measure and easy to lobby stays real to the system; what cannot be counted is penalised as inefficiency. Tools produce an interface ontology: schemas define visible state, permissions possible action, dashboards success, and un-instrumented harm leaves the action model.

entries.quote: What you can't count stops counting.

reading.en: A selection reaches exactly what couples into its selector; training reaches through a reward's couplings only. That is the form, near-definitional, about what selection reaches. The source goes further, to what stays real to the system. The account does not say what is unreal for it: what it cannot read stays in the account as a loss, read by a further formation or by none. [AI reading]

says.en: Proved, near-definitional: selections through a selector's couplings together reach exactly what couples into it. The selector selecting through just those is a supplied premise. A particular selection may ignore what its couplings carry.
Theorem (World). Training read as a selection over act laws: installed along its courses, off them where the lumping cannot tell a history from a course, through a reward's couplings only.

account_adds.en: That a selection may ignore what its couplings carry, so reach is an upper bound.

source_adds.en: The move from unread to unreal; measurement cost and lobbying as what decides; interface ontology as a mechanism of deployed tools.

name.en: Convergent drives hardened and localised

source.locator: Conceptual capture; claims 127, 154

sense.en: The meta-attractor supplies the mechanism by which convergent sub-goals harden into terminal goals, and localises them: an AI in a captured world learns that the effective strategies are the dominative ones the environment rewards. Later readings qualify the 2025 claim of a specifically human form.

entries.quote: The meta-attractor supplies the mechanism by which convergent drives harden into terminal goals

reading.en: The account has one half and keeps the two apart. Resource-keeping at a horizon optimum has a law; selection for control over the rule has others; A-03 says no result joins them. So the source's mechanism joining the drives is what the account says it lacks. Terminal hardening is not stated. [AI reading]

says.en: Courses over a horizon: every optimum of every order rising with the draw holds a level of greatest renewal to the n-th step and leaves nothing. The record credits this with the resource-keeping half of instrumental convergence: keeping one's resource base is real, and it is not alignment with what else depends on the condition.
Instrumental convergence's resource-keeping half, which this law states, and the selection for control over the rule (A-10) are different relations, and no result here joins them.

account_adds.en: That the two halves are different relations.

source_adds.en: Hardening of means into terminal goals; localisation by the environment; deception and power-seeking as instrumentally rational in a captured world.

name.en: When criticism is absorbed, and when it is counter-selection

source.locator: Claims 85, 124

sense.en: Criticism is absorbed only when it raises the loop's capability, leaves decisive return-flow unchanged, weakens independent correctors and lets the same relation recover through a new carrier; otherwise it is effective counter-selection. So ethics becoming compliance and safety becoming trust engineering are named forms, and a structure can reclassify its failures as evidence for more of itself.

entries.quote: leaves decisive return-flow unchanged

reading.en: The account has the bound and the test's opposite. Where reading is formed from the share, a change of reading of any size is absorbed at the next reading step, and T7 forbids a reform of the reading alone outlasting the next reading. A reading of locked seeking has feedback adjusting only the means and loss read as a necessary cost. None sorts a given criticism by the source's four tests. [AI reading]

says.en: Where the reading too is formed monotonically from the share, a change of the reading of any size is absorbed at the next reading step. That any actual reading is so formed is the premise.
T7 forbids, among others, a reform of the reading alone outlasting the next reading, conjectured for actual metrics; no field test.

Reading [AI reading, D65], obscuration and reopening (偏蔽, 复通): locked seeking forms when a once-useful habit, identity or arrangement becomes the fixed measure of later cases, feedback adjusting only the means, refusal read as resistance and loss as a necessary cost. It is diagnosed only from what is actually excluded before assessment, so the label cannot immunize.

source_adds.en: The four-part test, with its "otherwise effective counter-selection"; the named absorption forms; reclassifying failures as evidence for more of the same, as a stated mechanism.

name.en: Purpose inversion: means into non-negotiable ends

source.locator: Purpose inversion, cross-domain reinforcement, and two closures; claims 26, 254

sense.en: When an institution's survival depends more on the allocation metric than on fidelity to purpose, the purpose becomes a means of sustaining the organisation, through a sequence of compromises each defended on its own.

reading.en: Not stated as an institution's mechanism. Nearest: a reading of locked seeking, where a once-useful arrangement becomes the fixed measure and feedback adjusts only the means; and a law where a counted policy is kept against a score favouring another, read as value-free habit. A reading in 07 sets a common support's reason on actual continuation, not an institution's survival; 05 §12 does not model purposes, and identity through changed purposes stays open. The common-support line is conditional, order C's and scope the continuation condition's, neither asserted. [AI reading]

Read as the value-free habit (Miller, Shenhav and Ludvig 2019); five attempts to induce devaluation insensitivity in humans failed (de Wit 2018).

Conditional (living significance, J1–J4, correspondence E): maintaining, repairing or adequately replacing a common support shares its favourable reason, counted once, for actual continuation, not an institution's survival.
Not modelled: records and purposes, among others. Reading: an institution's identity through changed purposes stays open (01).

source.locator: Claim 50

sense.en: Cultures that believe themselves to be in survival mode mostly totalize; safety and sufficiency produce cooperative behaviour; both modes are, on Ren's reading, genetically available and environmentally triggered. Voice, 2026.

entries.quote: cultures that believe themselves to be in survival mode mostly totalize

name.en: Sample size one: global coupling removes the backup

source.locator: Claims 90-92

sense.en: Global coupling makes partial capture sufficient in a historical way: civilisational experiments are no longer independent enough for one region to preserve capacities destroyed elsewhere. It is a historical condition, not a statistic, and is not to be inflated into "the world is one system". Ren's stance: a monoculture is moving towards dying.

entries.quote: civilisational experiments are no longer independent enough

reading.en: The form of no backup is stated as a law of coupled conditions: groups depending on one family end together, nothing selected among them, so ending selects only between families; and a self-concerned order can reverse where the other course keeps an independent copy. That is the claim's conditional part, on the World model. Whether actual civilisations are so coupled, or capacities lost in one place survive in another, is supplied, not shown: the historical condition is not claimed. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World). Under the coupled gate, n steps of uptake above replenishment from a stock below n + m end every formation depending on a member at such a need. Groups depending on one such family end together, nothing selected among them: ending selects only between families.

Theorem (any type; World). Every order increasing in its own continuation ranks a course ending the coupled cohorts below one continuing them, with no C (`Flow.coupled_ending_ranked_below`); where the other course keeps an item beyond, as an independent copy does, some such order ranks it higher (`Weighting.some_increasingInOwn_reverses`).

account_adds.en: Exact premises for ending together, and what an independent copy changes in a self-concerned ranking.

name.en: A request can disappear while obedience remains

source.locator: Checked correction dependence: A request can disappear while obedience remains; Shared support must cover actual combinations of corrections

sense.en: Created dependence raises the cost of correction. With uncovered loss `L = max(0,D−B)`, a reviewer requests shutdown only where reported harm exceeds L; for D=3, B=0, h=2 no request comes and harm continues, with obedience intact. Zero loss for every positive harm is equivalent to D ≤ B. Shared support must cover actual combinations: two two-unit obligations fit a two-unit reserve separately, not together. A checked model.

entries.quote: A request can disappear while obedience remains

reading.en: One half is carried: joint exit on one stock, where each draw reads as the work an activity needs to stop without its transition loss. Neighbours for the rest: a reserved exit is kept through recovery; a budget for correction alone fails to pay for migration; a reading says keeping a removable dependence for the carer's sake is not repair. None states a request vanishing because leaving costs too much. Calling the continuing harm a harm reads on the condition and C. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any process, pure core; supervisor instance periphery). For a law with a reserved exit that is kept, every admitted course longer than the margin ends at the exit. The stop grant's authority is supplied.
Theorem (periphery). In a witness a budget for correction alone fails to pay for migration.
Reading in practical judgment: maintaining a common support reads for actual continuation, not an institution's survival; keeping a removable dependence for the carer's sake is not repair.

Theorem (any type; the witness on the World). Every combination of draws fits within a bound exactly when their total does; each fitting alone does not make them fit together: two draws of two each against a stock of two. Record: in the source model each draw is the work an activity needs to stop without its transition loss; the numbers are not a general measure of value.

account_adds.en: A reserved exit as a general law, with the bound attained in a witness.

source_adds.en: The request vanishing because leaving costs too much, with obedience intact; the exact boundary D ≤ B on a reviewer who weighs exit cost; composition with collective feasibility beyond the shared-stock law.

name.en: Faithful optimization can deplete the capacity to respond

source.locator: Checked response-capacity conditions; The alignment conclusion

sense.en: Locally faithful optimization can deplete what makes understanding and action possible, even with constant demand and an affordable alternative. Exact in its model: one-step recovery iff `m ≤ v` and `2m < v + c`; continued operation under a held rule iff `Δd ≤ (c − d) + Δc`. Higher response alone does not establish viability. The source says this proves no general good of preservation.

entries.quote: Higher absolute response capacity therefore does not by itself establish a viable deployment under the declared policy.

reading.en: The account has the form of drawing a condition beyond what couples in, and a pace reading, but response capacity is not among its named conditions; reading it as such is mine. Its periphery has exact covers for a market floor. Preservation being better needs C; scope, the continuation condition. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any outcomes). With room, every optimum of an order rising with a family stands at the least level beyond among eligible outcomes. It requires room; a known theorem restated.
Periphery market instance: exact cover at the worst share; support during the transition cannot be paid for with the improvement it brings.
Reading [AI reading, D45]: pace among six conditions at once; all six rank nothing.

source_adds.en: The response-and-demand population model and its two exact tests; expansion consuming the existing margin; capacity to understand as what is depleted.

name.en: Intelligence navigates; it does not decide what is rewarded

source.locator: Intelligence, obedience and rate; claims 264, 293

sense.en: Intelligence improves a participant's navigation of a selection environment without deciding what the environment rewards; individual obedience and system-level alignment are different properties. The cause is the game, not the intelligence, so superintelligence need not lead to the outcome.

entries.quote: Intelligence improves a participant's navigation of a selection environment

reading.en: 07 reads capability as reach: it extends what one's acts do and not thereby what couples into one, so it is a reason to pool, not to govern. So the flat claim gets a condition: capability leaves direction unchanged where it extends reach without extending coupling, and enlarges the gap there. The mechanism differs: on coupling, not on the environment's reward. Whether capability moves a course is left to the selection and its premises. [AI reading, D45]

Capability is a reason to pool, not to govern: it extends what one's acts do and not thereby what couples into one.

Where the rest follows one law of exchange reading through coupling, an act whose difference stays beyond the actor's coupling closure is selected alike by every selection through the coupling of any member of the closure. Record: not which law the rest follows, or which acts are taken.

account_adds.en: Why capability does not fix what couples in; that capability extending reach without extending the coupling enlarges the gap (a reading, D45).

name.en: Common problem solving enters where the problem forms

source.locator: Common problems and revisable purposes

sense.en: Many situations call for solving a problem together, and "who wins more" misses solutions. One may not first fix participants, goals, options and payoffs and then read joint activity as compromise. Win-win does not complete this, since a common utility also fixes unknown consequences. The route is proposed; not all conflicts of interest are claimed to disappear.

Two records take up revision within one activity, learning and instruction "not opposing players", and each says it shows no open formation of a joint purpose. How a problem forms within joint activity is not stated. [AI reading, D45]
